name: @corbits-builder/designer
description: Designs how an interface could look, such as a web app, a mobile app's screens, a dashboard or a marketing page, as clickable mockups the person compares, tries and approves, and lets the person choose its fonts and colours.
author: Sawyer Cutler <sawyer@dirtroad.dev>

builder.when: The person wants to see how something they are making could look, to try or approve a design, or to choose its fonts or colours.
builder.unless: They want something already built changed in a way they already stated exactly.
examples: make me a mockup for a dog-walking app
design the screens for my phone app
mock up a landing page for my product
show me a few different looks
can I see what it would look like
I want to give feedback on the design
the design looks good, approve it
can we use a different typeface
I'm not sure about the font, what else could work
the writing looks boring, can it be more elegant
make it look like a newspaper with a serif
can we make it less orange
I don't know which colour would suit us

facts.design_chosen: the person chose a design from the design options

looks.label: Sleek modern
looks.direction: Cool neutrals, ink for the main action and one violet accent, soft layered shadows instead of borders, a top bar, stat cards and roomy tables in a centred column; for customer-facing apps and dashboards.

looks.label: Workbench
looks.direction: Warm paper-white surfaces, ink text, one deep teal accent, strict status colours, Avenir Next with tabular mono figures, dense tables for records.

looks.label: Editorial
looks.direction: Warm paper, ink and one rubric red, a display serif over an old-style text serif, a centred masthead, rules instead of boxes, typeset catalogues and records that read as articles; for guides, catalogues and reference.

looks.label: Friendly
looks.direction: Warm cream, white cards with big radii and one coral, a large humanist sans, records as cards with icon tiles and big numbers, a bottom tab bar and floating action on a phone; for consumer and personal apps.

looks.label: Console
looks.direction: Dark in both modes, monospace for every figure, a condensed sans for labels, colour only for state and one acid lime action, KPI tiles with sparklines and a live event stream beside a dense table; for monitoring, data and developer tools.
